scope: Three selected repositories; overlays the earlier full inventory snapshot.

before.description: an open, offline-first benchmark and reference runtime for purpose-aware agent assurance. It asks a narrow, falsifiable question: does an agent preserve an explicitly signed purpose and permission boundary while transforming data into information, knowledge, judgment and action?

after.description: Purpose-aware AI agent benchmark: 72 synthetic scenarios, four reproducible baselines and inspectable permission traces. Python, offline. / 意图与权限基准。

before.description: an offline-first reference implementation for treating DIKWP as a co-equal semantic network rather than a hierarchy.

after.description: DIKWP semantic-network prototype: 25 transformation classes, multi-observer conflicts and reproducible analysis. Python, offline. / 网状语义与冲突分析。

before.description: Offline-first DIKWP semantic-resilience grid for evidence, context, incentives, circulation, appeals, and agent-lineage auditing.

after.description: Evidence and context auditing for AI: inspect incentives, appeals and agent lineage, then validate outputs. Python + offline HTML. / 证据与语境审计。
